# Wagner SprayTech

> > Wagner SprayTech manufactures professional and DIY paint sprayers, heat guns, and power tools including FLEXiO, Control Pro, FURNO, and PaintStick product lines.

Wagner SprayTech is a leading manufacturer of painting and finishing equipment for homeowners and professionals. The site features product information, DIY project tutorials, troubleshooting guides, and support resources for their spray painting systems, cordless heat guns, and surface preparation tools.

## Key Topics

- FLEXiO Paint Sprayers
- FURNO Heat Guns
- Control Pro Airless Sprayers
- PaintStick EZ Roller
- DIY Painting Projects
- Outdoor Painting & Refinishing
- Surface Preparation
- Spray Technique
- Product Date Codes
- Warranty Registration
- Heat Gun Accessories
- Deck & Shed Painting
- RV & Interior Painting
- Troubleshooting Support

## Product Support & Troubleshooting

- [How to Find Your Wagner Product Date Code](https://www.wagnerspraytech.com/support/paintstick-ez-roller-date-code-location): PaintStick EZ Roller date code location for warranty registration
